name: Oshiego no Yuuwaku ~Katei Kyoushi Inwai Lesson~
original_name: 教え子の誘惑～家庭教師淫猥レッスン～
source: Haruhiko is hired by his aunt to tutor Yumi, his female cousin. Everything is going well until Yumi ask him if he already have experienced sex. And before he knows it, their roles reversed. It is now Yumi tutoring him about sex.
translation: 鸟谷春彦受姑母之托，为表妹狩野弓美补习功课。一切原本十分顺利，直到弓美问他有没有性经验。回过神来，两人的角色已经颠倒，反倒由弓美为他上起了性爱课。
